topic: How title loans work and why they're risky

sources.claim: Title loans average ~300% APR; average borrower renews/flips loan ~8 times paying ~$2,300 in fees on a $1,000 loan; 1 in 5 borrowers has vehicle repossessed
sources.source: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau research, via Center for Responsible Lending summary
